<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Vegeta's Saiyan Pod''' (Vegeta's Pod) is the crashed Saiyan pod where [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]] waits, in the rocky lands of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. '''Bulma''' is here too: many story deliveries and the sidequests that unlock new [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] destinations go through her.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]]''' teaches ki skills, his signature ki attacks (Galick Gun, Big Bang Attack, Final Flash and more) and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fake Moon|Fake Moon]], and runs the '''Gravity''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He has no alignment requirement.
* '''Bulma''' is a quest NPC. Talk to her for story deliveries, and for sidequests such as ''Temporal Comm-Link'' and ''Otherworld Drive'', which unlock the Time Chamber and Otherworld destinations of your Space Pod (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dimensions#Travelling between worlds|Dimensions]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:10-->
The pod generates once per world, in rocky biomes. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Vegeta's Saiyan Pod Map''' at trade tier 5, for 1 Red Scouter and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate vegeta_pod}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:11-->
Like every master's home, the pod can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:12-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:13-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 14, ''Repairing the Saiyan Pod'': find Vegeta's Saiyan Pod and give Bulma 8 Blocks of Iron, 4 Blocks of Redstone and 4 Diamonds.
* Saiyan Saga quest 15, ''Prepare for Namek'': talk to Bulma; the reward is a Saiyan [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]].
</translate>
